utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Dane — I’ll keep an eye out for the drop-off time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’m still a bit fuzzy on the exact list, but I can help check it with you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I appreciate it — just let me know what you find out, and I’ll go from there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Just waiting on Faye’s message after pickup, then I can lock in the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — once Faye’s message comes through, I can keep the supplies ready and we can lock in the drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll let you know as soon as Faye messages me, then we can lock in the drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll bring the wrench and screwdriver later today.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — thanks, Gus. That’ll help a lot for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to help — I’ll drop them off later today, and if anything else comes up, just give me a shout.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — that’d really help. I’ll keep the coffee warm and do my best not to mix up the boxes again.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll head over later and let you know what they’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Vik — I’ll be here with the coffee and the labels, if I can keep them straight.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll check our supplies and see what we can bring to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming, Cleo — are you still handling the repair drive list? I’m checking off what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — I’m still on the repair drive list and checking our supplies now. I’ll let you know what we can bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m already spreading the word and I’ll send anyone with questions your way. Just let me know as soon as Faye’s message comes through.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’m still on for around 2, and I’ll help sort the tools and keep the boxes straight.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, 2 works for me — I’ll keep spreading the word and send any questions your way.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll keep spreading the word and bring the tool list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — that helps a lot. I’m still hoping we’ve got enough trucks and someone steady at check-in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll ask around for trucks and a steady check-in person.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still checking the exact drop-off time for the repair drive, but I do know it’s this Saturday at the community center. I’ll let you know the moment I have the final details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — Saturday at the community center works for now. Please let me know as soon as you’ve got the exact drop-off time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’m on it and I’ll send the exact drop-off time as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Rey — I’ll keep everything organized and send the updated details so everyone knows the repair drive is Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa — that sounds great. I’ll help keep things sorted and be there Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep the volunteer list and details updated so everything runs smoothly on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m keeping an ear out — if I hear anything about the trucks or who’s on check-in, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I really appreciate you keeping watch and passing anything along.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll keep listening for any truck updates or check-in news and let you know right away if I hear something useful.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time are you available for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m free later today after 3. Let’s keep it simple — I’ll bring a clear list if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect — after 3 works. I’ll send you the drop-off time and keep it simple from there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m still handling the repair drive list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great — I’m still on it and can help check off whatever’s left. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Sam — just help me check off whatever’s still open on the repair drive list.
